text: /* @component: .f-number */ (function () { if (window.__fNumberInit) return; window.__fNumberInit = true; document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { const btnDec = e.target.closest('.num-btn--dec'); if (btnDec) { const parent = btnDec.closest('.f-number') || btnDec.parentElement; const input = parent ? parent.querySelector('input') : null; if (input && input.stepDown) { input.stepDown(); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } return; } const btnInc = e.target.closest('.num-btn--inc'); if (btnInc) { const parent = btnInc.closest('.f-number') || btnInc.parentElement; const input = parent ? parent.querySelector('input') : null; if (input && input.stepUp) { input.stepUp(); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } return; } }); })(); /* @end: .f-number */
